names.en: I Reside in All Living Beings and Heaven and Earth
names.ru: Я Обитаю во Всех Живых Существах, Небе и Земле

summary.text: I Reside in All Living Beings and Heaven and Earth is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's full-strength luck path killer move. A golden light pillar forms, then leaves him amplified across offense, defense, movement, and healing.

claims.text: During the battle over spectral heaven, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable reaches his limit and activates this luck path killer move at full strength. A dazzling golden light pillar forms at once, tens of thousands of feet tall and very thick. He stands inside it with limbs spread while the activation lasts about nine breaths. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s attacks are blocked by the pillar. Fang Yuan finds that striking it shakes his own luck and risks having that luck absorbed, so he stops.

When the pillar dissipates, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable is covered in golden radiance with bulging muscles and expanded build. He tells Star Constellation Immortal Venerable that the move’s range covers the entire five regions and that there was no way to avoid her. Fang Yuan judges that it forcibly extracts external luck and enforces it on Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s body, and that it can influence heaven and earth luck as well as all living beings luck so that luck revolves around him. Cooking Luck Pot and heavenly web protection veil keep Fang Yuan’s luck from being influenced. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s defensive methods against luck path are broken and rendered useless. After activation, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s luck rises to an unprecedented level, and with his combat system his strength receives an all-rounded amplification.

The move forcibly extracts external luck. The more it is used, the less remains, like a rootless tree or a sourceless body of water. When the effect dissipates completely, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s luck falls into a weakened state that lasts for a while before returning to normal. As the first activation decreases in effect, he activates the move again. A golden light pillar spans heaven and earth once more, and his luck and battle strength rise back. The move can be used continuously, but its after-effects increase with each use. His combat system is based on positive luck, so low luck would reduce his battle strength significantly.

After he has used the move twice in a short period, the huge drawback is that it leaves him in a weakened state for some time. He has to conceal himself and get through that weakened period in secret. If he exposes the weakness, the move’s value and usability would fall immensely later.
Fang Yuan does not know about that drawback of using the killer move.
